The '''Arms Interdiction Task Force''' was a branch of the [[New Republic Security Force]] assigned to handle [[Black market/Legends|black market]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealers]]. [[Drev Prilarca]] was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the task force who was working on obtaining information related to the arms dealer known as "[[Gundark (arms dealer)|Gundark]]."<ref name="GFTPG" />
